notes.title: Demo-V0.2.0 is live!!!
notes.content:
🔧 New Features:
1. Added a new protagonist model.

2. Reworked the combat flow and introduced some deck-building (DBG) elements.

3. Added new enemy skill configurations to increase combat difficulty.

4. Added a player healing skill, and removed the cooldown time for player skills — you can now use your skills limitlessly!!!

5. Status effect system is now live.

6. A slot machine feature has been added to the idle mode for enhanced variety.

 
✨ Experience Improvements:
1. A new screen visual effect has been added — you can disable it in the settings if you prefer the classic look.

2. Improved some UI visuals and presentation.

 
🐞 Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed some minor bugs (but there might be new ones lurking — stay tuned!).

 

========================== Combat System Update ==========================

Low-value dice are no longer useless! You can now place them into the buffer zone to help reduce its total points. Enemies will now scale their attacks based on your buffer zone's point total — so using lower dice strategically can mitigate incoming damage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/891809bf6b1e76363b315e8e32d8e55b4d37a581.gif"]

On the flip side, high-value dice now have even more impact. If your dice points exceed the enemy's buffer requirement, your attack will be amplified, dealing bonus damage! So try to maximize your dice values using any skills or abilities you have!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/3733cc0bb09d13afe167723a58e3d5d0ad87081c.gif"]

 

========================== Idle Gameplay Update ==========================

We've added our main character to the main scene! Yes, finally — we have a protagonist! 😎

Expect to see all sorts of cool and fun new features built around this stylish figure in the near future!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/39b2c35b8d366405a316ce148d18d1d11ec62d8f.gif"]

We've also reworked the idle system in the base:

You now have to defeat enemies within a time limit to break through and increase your attack power in outpost battles!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/8c6a26d39fa1be639da466b7f0587e0b93530242.gif"]

While fighting enemies, you'll now see a new item drop: Happiness Bonds.

These can be used to manually trigger the slot machine on screen — granting you a huge money reward!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/c739d155cd4b54d42fd6606182b06026365bb1fd.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/44ba03795442ce49f60e53271e2354e622238779.gif"]

notes.title: Demo Patch - V0.1.2
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665535/7a11d72a611e0557a2c92efdaf6cf6221bd2d4a8.png"]🐛 Bug Fixes

Fixed some incorrect in-game descriptions

Fixed the issue where the game would pause when running in the background (I'm such a dummy for missing this!)

Fixed a bug where dice could be dragged from a shielded buffer zone to another buffer even if they didn’t meet the required value

Fixed a bug where skill tooltips wouldn’t show when the skill was on cooldown

Fixed an issue where skill borders didn’t highlight when activation conditions were met

🛠 Improvements

Added some basic operation/tutorial guidance to help new players

Enhance the visual effect when dice values change

Minor tweaks to other visual effects
